Specification: This specification models a simple hour counter over a single state variable hr. The initial-state predicate requires hr to be in the range 1..12, and the next-state action increments hr unless it is 12, in which case it wraps around to 1. The temporal specification HC requires the initial condition and that every step satisfies HCnxt as a behavior over hr, and the theorem asserts that HC implies the invariant []HCini.
